source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Document fully why brakes failed or, if you know the brake test machine is in good working order, list double the number of factors why you believe the load sensing proportioning valve is the reason for brake imbalance or incorrect braking force.
3. List all previous brake tests performed on this tractor/trailer combination for the past 12 months.
4. List date and place of last brake adjustment both tractor
   and trailer.
5. List date and place of last brake maintenance performed on the tractor and trailer.
6. Provide photo documentation with the brake report.
7. List name of service technician or shop technician that performed the brake adjustment or brake maintenance.
8. List full name and CVIP# of person performing the brake test
